Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: This step initiated an unproductive summarize loop in the March 2021 PDF instead of switching to targeted extraction (e.g., figure captions or axis ranges), entering a loop that should not have been entered. As the loop entry, it set a pattern of repeated, ineffective actions without obtaining the needed time spans, making recovery increasingly difficult. There was no data fabrication, but this was the first decisive misstep that derailed progress.
